lines: By faith I see Mount Calvary,
By faith I see that cruel tree;
I see His pain, I see His strife,
By faith I see my ransomed life.
In awe I see his flesh to so torn,
In awe I see the peoples' scorn;
God turns away, I hear His plea,
In awe I see His love for me.
Thru tears I see that perfect blood;
Thru tears I see that blessed flood;
He cries, "Tis done!"; the battle's o'er,
Thru tears He sees my sins no more.
